        记录一次 bytenode .jsc 逆向实战，涵盖 V8 9.4 字节码定位、工具踩坑、源码 patch 与 d8 反编译流程。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="实战还原-v8-bytenode-保护-jsv8-字节码分析记录">实战还原 V8 bytenode 保护 JS（V8 字节码分析记录）</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>V8 字节码分析，简单写写在前辈们的基础上，又遇到些什么问题<sub>（绝对不是我水不出很长的文章的问题）</sub><br>
（如有错漏，敬请指正，因为是在弄完后过了很久才写的）<br>
我的blog：<a href="https://blog.dorimu.cn/2025/03/30/jsc-decompilation/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">blog.dorimu.cn</a></p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x00-前言">0x00 前言</h2>
<p>拿到一个需要逆向分析的 JS  <code>start.js</code>。</p>
<p>目标环境：</p>
<ul>
<li>Node.js：<code>16.14.0</code></li>
<li>对应 V8：<code>9.4.146.24-node.20</code>（flag hash <code>ed0ab240</code>）</li>
</ul>
<p>核心代码如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const vm = require('vm');
const v8 = require('v8');
const zlib = require('zlib');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const Module = require('module');
v8.setFlagsFromString('--no-lazy');
v8.setFlagsFromString('--no-flush-bytecode');
global.generateScript=function(cachedData, filename) {
   cachedData = zlib.brotliDecompressSync(cachedData);
   fixBytecode(cachedData);
   const length = readSourceHash(cachedData);
   let dummyCode = '';
   if (length &gt; 1) {
         dummyCode = '"' + '\u200b'.repeat(length - 2) + '"';
   }
   const script = new vm.Script(dummyCode, {
         cachedData,
         filename
   });
   if (script.cachedDataRejected) {
         throw new Error('');
   }
   return script;
}
global.compileCode = function(javascriptCode, compress) {
   const script = new vm.Script(javascriptCode, {
         produceCachedData: true
   });
   let bytecodeBuffer = (script.createCachedData &amp;&amp; script.createCachedData.call) ?
         script.createCachedData() :
         script.cachedData;
   if (compress) bytecodeBuffer = zlib.brotliCompressSync(bytecodeBuffer);
   return bytecodeBuffer;
};
global.fixBytecode = function(bytecodeBuffer) {
   const dummyBytecode = compileCode('');
   dummyBytecode.subarray(12, 16).copy(bytecodeBuffer, 12);
};
global.readSourceHash = function(bytecodeBuffer) {
   return bytecodeBuffer.subarray(8, 12).reduce((sum, number, power) =&gt; sum += number * Math.pow(256, power), 0);
};
try {
   Module._extensions['.jsc'] = function(fileModule, filename) {
         const data = fs.readFileSync(filename, 'utf8')
         const bytecodeBuffer = Buffer.from(data, 'base64');
         const script = generateScript(bytecodeBuffer, filename);

         function require(id) {
            return fileModule.require(id);
         }
         require.resolve = function(request, options) {
            return Module._resolveFilename(request, fileModule, false, options);
         };
         if (process.main) {
            require.main = process.main;
         }
         require.extensions = Module._extensions;
         require.cache = Module._cache;
         const compiledWrapper = script.runInThisContext({
            filename: filename,
            lineOffset: 0,
            columnOffset: 0,
            displayErrors: true
         });
         const dirname = path.dirname(filename);
         const args = [
            fileModule.exports, require, fileModule, filename, dirname, process, global
         ];
         return compiledWrapper.apply(fileModule.exports, args);
   };
} catch (ex) {
   console.error('xrequire:' + ex.message);
}
require("${codeScript}")
</code></pre>
<p>经过搜索资料发现：<br>
这就是<strong>V8 cachedData / bytenode</strong> 方案。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x01-第一次尝试view8">0x01 第一次尝试：View8</h2>
<p>定位到 bytecode 后，我先上了 <code>View8</code>：<br>
<a href="https://github.com/suleram/View8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/suleram/View8</a></p>
<p>然后配套 <code>9.4.146.24.exe</code> 去跑反编译。</p>
<p>发现问题：</p>
<ul>
<li>输出一点代码后自动崩溃退出。</li>
<li>View8 因 d8 崩溃只导出 23 个外围函数，关键的函数基本丢失。</li>
</ul>
<p>当时第一反应是项目太久没维护，又去github找别的项目。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x02-第二次尝试jsc2js">0x02 第二次尝试：jsc2js</h2>
<p>又看了 <code>jsc2js</code>：<br>
<a href="https://github.com/xqy2006/jsc2js" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/xqy2006/jsc2js</a></p>
<p>这个仓库新一些，也有 patch + CI 体系。<br>
把 patch 套到 <code>v8 9.4.146.24</code>，结果仍然和第一轮差不多。</p>
<p>这时候基本就炸毛了<sub>（先躺一会）</sub>：<br>
字节码本来就不太好 hook，现成工具又不稳定。</p>
<p>于是查阅相关资料：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.aynakeya.com/articles/ctf/a-quick-guide-to-disassemble-v8-bytecode/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.aynakeya.com/articles/ctf/a-quick-guide-to-disassemble-v8-bytecode/</a></li>
<li><a href="https://rce.moe/2025/01/07/v8-bytecode-decompiler/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://rce.moe/2025/01/07/v8-bytecode-decompiler/</a></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>V8 bytecode 就是 V8 自己序列化的一段内部数据。<br>
想稳定拿结果，必须回到 V8 源码层改输出逻辑。<br>
不同 V8 版本在字节码层差异很大，尤其是 opcode、参数语义、寄存器布局。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x03-第三次尝试拉-v8-仓库">0x03 第三次尝试：拉 V8 仓库</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bat">@echo off
set PATH=E:\Dev\SDKs\depot_tools;%PATH%
set DEPOT_TOOLS_WIN_TOOLCHAIN=0

mkdir v8_941
cd v8_941

echo solutions = [{ &gt; .gclient
echo   "name": "v8", &gt;&gt; .gclient
echo   "url": "https://chromium.googlesource.com/v8/v8.git@9.4.146.24", &gt;&gt; .gclient
echo   "deps_file": "DEPS", &gt;&gt; .gclient
echo   "managed": False, &gt;&gt; .gclient
echo   "custom_deps": {}, &gt;&gt; .gclient
echo }] &gt;&gt; .gclient

git clone --depth=1 --branch 9.4.146.24 https://chromium.googlesource.com/v8/v8.git v8
gclient sync -D --no-history
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x04-patch--编译参数">0x04 patch + 编译参数</h2>
<p>先patch，再单独构建 d8：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bat">cd /d &lt;dir&gt;\v8_941\v8
python ..\..\apply_patches_v8_94.py .
gn gen out/release
ninja -C out/release d8
</code></pre>
<p>构建参数：</p>
<pre><code class="language-gn">dcheck_always_on = false
is_clang = false
is_component_build = false
is_debug = false
target_cpu = "x64"
use_custom_libcxx = false
v8_monolithic = true
v8_use_external_startup_data = false
v8_static_library = true
v8_enable_disassembler = true
v8_enable_object_print = true
treat_warnings_as_errors = false
v8_enable_pointer_compression = false
v8_enable_31bit_smis_on_64bit_arch = false
v8_enable_lite_mode = false
v8_enable_i18n_support = true
v8_enable_webassembly = true

</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x05-改动阶段">0x05 改动阶段</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>真男人就要硬刚v8，部分diff我就不贴出来了，把问题和思路贴一下，欸嘿~</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x06-问题一cacheddata-反序列化被拒绝">0x06 问题一：<code>cachedData</code> 反序列化被拒绝</h2>
<p><code>CodeSerializer::Deserialize</code> 默认会严检 magic/version/flags/hash/checksum/source hash。<br>
如果任何一项没通过，它会直接 reject 掉这份缓存，返回空对象。</p>
<p><code>src/snapshot/code-serializer.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@@ SerializedCodeData::SanityCheck
-  SanityCheckResult result = SanityCheckWithoutSource();
-  if (result != CHECK_SUCCESS) return result;
-  ...
-  return CHECK_SUCCESS;
+  return SerializedCodeData::SanityCheckResult::CHECK_SUCCESS;

@@ SerializedCodeData::SanityCheckWithoutSource
-  if (this-&gt;size_ &lt; kHeaderSize) return INVALID_HEADER;
-  uint32_t magic_number = GetMagicNumber();
-  if (magic_number != kMagicNumber) return MAGIC_NUMBER_MISMATCH;
-  ...
-  if (Checksum(ChecksummedContent()) != c) return CHECKSUM_MISMATCH;
-  return CHECK_SUCCESS;
+  return SerializedCodeData::SanityCheckResult::CHECK_SUCCESS;
</code></pre>
<p><code>src/snapshot/deserializer.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">@@ Deserializer&lt;IsolateT&gt;::Deserializer
-  CHECK_EQ(magic_number_, SerializedData::kMagicNumber);
+  /*
+  CHECK_EQ(magic_number_, SerializedData::kMagicNumber);
+  */
@@ ReadSingleBytecodeData
+  std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Unknown serializer bytecode: 0x%02x\n", data);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x07-问题二反汇编打印阶段栈溢出">0x07 问题二：反汇编/打印阶段栈溢出</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>这里就是之前view8打印不出来的主要问题：</p>
</blockquote>
<ol>
<li><code>BytecodeArray::Disassemble</code></li>
<li>打常量池</li>
<li>命中 <code>SharedFunctionInfo</code></li>
<li><code>SharedFunctionInfoPrint</code></li>
<li>再次 <code>Disassemble</code></li>
<li>深度叠加，最终栈爆</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>改动：TLS guard + SEH</li>
</ul>
<p><code>src/diagnostics/objects-printer.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+thread_local int g_in_bytecode_disasm = 0;
...
+  ++g_in_bytecode_disasm;
+  hbc-&gt;Disassemble(*(c-&gt;os));
+  --g_in_bytecode_disasm;
@@ SharedFunctionInfoPrint
-  PrintSourceCode(os);
+  // PrintSourceCode(os);
+  int exc = SehWrapCall(DoBcDisasm, &amp;ctx);
+  if (exc != 0) { os &lt;&lt; "&lt;BytecodeArray Disassemble CRASHED ...&gt;"; }
</code></pre>
<p><code>src/objects/objects.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+extern thread_local int g_in_bytecode_disasm;
+void SafePrintSharedFunctionInfo(...);
+void SafePrintFixedArray(...);
...
 case SHARED_FUNCTION_INFO_TYPE:
+  if (g_in_bytecode_disasm &gt; 0) { break; }
+  SafePrintSharedFunctionInfo(shared, os);
 case FIXED_ARRAY_TYPE:
+  SafePrintFixedArray(FixedArray::cast(*this), os);
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>对应：d8 入口改成 BFS 平铺</li>
</ul>
<p><code>src/d8/d8.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+void Shell::LoadBytecode(...)
+std::deque&lt;i::Handle&lt;i::SharedFunctionInfo&gt;&gt; queue;
+std::unordered_set&lt;i::Address&gt; seen;
+while (!queue.empty()) { ... }
+global_template-&gt;Set(isolate, "loadBytecode",
+                     FunctionTemplate::New(isolate, LoadBytecode));
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="0x08-稳定性">0x08 稳定性</h2>
<h3 id="修-handle-生命周期和字节码迭代稳定性">修 Handle 生命周期和字节码迭代稳定性</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">-        i::HandleScope inner_scope(isolateInternal);
+        // No inner HandleScope here — child handles stored in queue/all_sfis
+        // must survive across iterations. outer_scope keeps them all alive.
...
-            i::BytecodeArray handle_storage = *hbca;
-            i::Handle&lt;i::BytecodeArray&gt; handle(
-                reinterpret_cast&lt;i::Address*&gt;(&amp;handle_storage));
-            i::interpreter::BytecodeArrayIterator iterator(handle);
+            // Use hbca directly — it's a proper Handle rooted in print_scope.
+            i::interpreter::BytecodeArrayIterator iterator(hbca);
...
+                // Re-derive base_address each iteration (GC-safe)
+                i::Address base_address = hbca-&gt;GetFirstBytecodeAddress();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="调试可见性--sfi-入队条件">调试可见性 + SFI 入队条件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+    printf("[DBG] root SFI ptr = 0x%p\n", reinterpret_cast&lt;void*&gt;(root-&gt;ptr()));
+    printf("[DBG] root HasBytecodeArray = %d\n", root_has_bc);
...
+            printf("[DBG]   cp[%d] raw=0x%p smi=%d\n", cp_index,
+                   reinterpret_cast&lt;void*&gt;(obj.ptr()), obj.IsSmi());
...
-            if (obj.IsSharedFunctionInfo()) {
+            if (!obj.IsSmi() &amp;&amp; obj.IsSharedFunctionInfo()) {
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="常量池可读性增强">常量池可读性增强</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">+const int kMaxLiteralElementsToPrint = 1024;
+std::function&lt;void(i::Object, int)&gt; print_compact_obj;
...
+if (value.IsArrayBoilerplateDescription()) { ... }
+if (value.IsFixedArray()) { ... }
+if (value.IsFixedDoubleArray()) { ... }
...
+print_compact_obj(obj, 0);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="其它">其它</h3>
<p><code>src/objects/string.cc</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-diff">-if (len &gt; kMaxShortPrintLength) {
+// if (len &gt; kMaxShortPrintLength) {
...
-accumulator-&gt;Add("%c", c);
+accumulator-&gt;Add("\\u%04x", c);
</code></pre>
